harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blocked usb_storage from loading on node1 (Alpine 3.23, kernel 6.18.7-0-lts) both immediately and persistently across reboots. Root cause required two fixes: (1) a standard modprobe blacklist (blacklist + install /bin/false) in /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf to stop hotplug/manual modprobe loads, and (2) removing usb-storage from the bootloader's kernel cmdline modules= list (/etc/update-extlinux.conf, regenerated via update-extlinux into /boot/extlinux.conf), since Alpine's initramfs force-loads modules named there independent of the modprobe blacklist. Verified across two full reboots (distinct boot_id each time) that the module never loads and explicit modprobe attempts now fail.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: usb_storage was loaded (lsmod), OS is Alpine Linux 3.23 (kernel 6.18.7-0-lts)
Unloaded usb_storage immediately via rmmod; confirmed modprobe now fails with install-command error
Captured baseline boot_id (33387ee8...), triggered first reboot (backgrounded sleep+reboot so the ack returned before disconnect), polled until node1 reachable again

Discovered post-reboot that usb_storage loaded anyway (boot_id changed to c3c15d79..., proving a genuine restart) — traced via dmesg to kernel cmdline 'modules=sd-mod,usb-storage,ext4,ena,gve', which Alpine's initramfs force-loads independent of the modprobe blacklist
Removed usb-storage from /etc/update-extlinux.conf 'modules=' line and regenerated /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux; unloaded the currently-loaded module again
Triggered second reboot, polled until node1 reachable again with a new boot_id (fe896758...), confirming a second genuine restart
Verified post-second-reboot: kernel cmdline no longer includes usb-storage, lsmod shows the module not loaded, and explicit modprobe usb_storage fails due to the blacklist/install directive

evidence.summary: Removed usb-storage from /etc/update-extlinux.conf modules= line and regenerated /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux; confirmed usb-storage no longer present in the generated APPEND line.

evidence.requirement: Second restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, changed boot identity proven, confirming the persistent fix survives an actual reboot
